AGENTS.md — hegelr

Source: AGENTS.md

R binding for the Hegel property-based testing engine (libhegel). See ARCHITECTURE.md for the full design and the binding contract — read it before changing src/ or R/.

Ground rules:

  • Base R only in Imports:. Suggests: for testthat/jsonlite.
  • The native engine is never a link-time dependency. src/ dlopens it.
  • Every src/ change must keep the wrapper table in §4 of ARCHITECTURE.md and the arity in src/init.c in sync.
  • Property bodies are plain R closures: stop() fails the case, tc$assume() rejects it, tc$draw() is the only randomness allowed.
  • Tests: offline tests must pass without the engine; online tests skip via skip_if_no_libhegel().
  • Engine ABI reference: hegel-rust/hegel-c/include/hegel.h (pinned version in R/libhegel.R).

Developed by Maximilian Scholz.
